fact: The International Union of Bakers and Confectioners (UIBC) named French chef Benoît Castel World Confectioner of the Year.
Benoît Castel received the UIBC award on July 14, 2026, in Singapore.
Benoît Castel is 54 years old and operates several patisseries in Paris.
French pastry chef Nina Métayer was crowned world champion by the UIBC three years prior to Benoît Castel.
Benoît Castel originates from the Brittany region in western France.
The best-selling pastry item at Benoît Castel's shops is a chocolate choux pastry.
